text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from accompanying 
Orfevre on a shopping trip...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...How noisy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Silence them.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The piercing toll of the bell, and the 
clamorous uproar of the masses...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: How unpleasant. Make them stop, at once.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: —Mmh!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...? Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Sparkly big sis, here's a present for you. 
It's fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The child held out a single lottery 
ticket. With this, we can try our luck at 
the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
You didn't look like you were having fun, 
big sis. I already had my turn, so don't 
worry about me. —Here!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...It is an offering presented by a child 
sacrificing their own flesh."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I will not treat you poorly.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you do it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Know that this has been entrusted to me 
and to my child. —You understand, do you 
not?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the pressure radiating from 
Orfevre, I plucked up my courage and spun 
the lottery machine's lever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...The grand prize, huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You think there's nothing more beyond 
this?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's the main attraction!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Well done, Trainer. I shall grant you my 
praise."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And what of the child?
choice_data_list:
I think they've already gone home, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Go search for it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
This is a ticket for that. We are pleased. 
We shall bestow a prize upon that one.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Bring them before me without delay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ran all over the place searching for the 
child who gave me the ticket... and just 
as exhaustion set in, by some miracle, I 
managed to find them.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —That, I give to you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A reward for entertaining the King. Accept 
it with gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: ...I don't need it!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
I know you, sparkly big sis. You're gonna 
run, right?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
"You know, I like cool things. I want you 
to do your best, Big Sis. So, here you 
go!"

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Get lots of rest, and do your super best! 
Sparkling Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I know.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—I will forgive your previous insolence. 
In return, swear an oath to me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That from here on out, every single step 
Orfevre takes will be burned into my 
memory.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I am far more 'cool' than anything you 
have ever known."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Put that ticket away.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"When the time comes, I will let you know. 
...Winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
comes first."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decided to hold onto the hot 
springs voucher... until the glorious day 
yet to come.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...1st prize, huh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A utterly mediocre result.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Oh. Well well... what a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, tonight's?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, grocery shopping. I'm in the mood to 
cook for myself, you see."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Are you... having Salisbury steak tonight?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I've decided.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It is a royal decree. You shall report to 
the kitchen alongside my elder sister.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Let's cook a dish that pairs well with the 
main hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, do you think you can make 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. If you make what feels 
right to you... I'm sure it will turn out 
well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something that goes great with hamburg 
steak, and a dish fit to present to a 
king... Thinking about it, its shape is 
beginning to come together.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Hmph. A "King's" Kid's Meal, is it?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I thought it looked like it was 
gonna be extravagant!

Yeah, I think it'll turn out pretty 
lavish!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the kids' meal I longed for as a 
child as a base, and adding everything 
else that brings joy... It is sure to 
satisfy both body and soul.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I think it's a wonderful idea, but... Do 
we have enough supplies?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There are fried foods too, so it might 
take a bit of effort.
choice_data_list:
That part... I'll power through with sheer 
willpower!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well then... If you need anything, 
please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Dream Journey and I made 
preparations for Orfevre... and everything 
was successfully set in place.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"From me, a simple zuppa made with nothing 
more than salt, pepper, bread, and 
tomatoes."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"To put it simply, it's a hearty soup with 
very little broth... yes."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"The touch of saltiness builds 
anticipation for the main dish without 
overpowering the flavor of the Salisbury 
steak. I tried to keep it simple and 
rustic."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my elder sister. Her 
attentiveness is impeccable.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —And what about you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Do not hesitate.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A mediocre mind's best attempt, I presume. 
Very well, speak it with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...Hooh. Quite extravagant."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it was hectic, but... you kept at 
it and did your best all on your own until 
the very end.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
... First of all, the concept itself is 
childish.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However, your spirit—your desire to uplift 
your King—has come through clearly.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, sit down as well. —Next, 
entertain me with conversation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with Orfevre in high spirits and 
Dream Journey watching over us with a 
gentle smile, the three of us enjoyed a 
special dinner together...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Not a bad offering. ...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hey, summon my subjects.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Have it all carried over. And then, go 
fetch more.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Naturally. It will not suffice.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —This is a king's banquet. Make it grand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, carrots were added on top of the 
already massive pile... resulting in a 
carrot party with two entire truckloads.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Here is the main dish, our carrot pie. We 
kneaded a variety of carrots into the 
dough to give it a rich and wonderful 
flavor.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed. ...A fine aroma.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You all sit, too. —Speak.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Then, allow me to report. Regarding 
the 'Royal Flowerbed' under our care...

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
The theme for early spring this year has 
been decided. I will manage everything 
thoroughly so that Lady Orfevre may enjoy 
herself!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well. —Next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the carrot-filled party went on, 
lively and full of fun.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to improve Orfevre's mood 
somehow. So, I desperately thought of a 
way to win her favor using the carrots I'd 
won...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly remember how last New Year's... 
Orfevre had demanded some kind of 
spectacle from me.
choice_data_list: ...Maybe I should do a party trick?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Interesting. Come, show me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre's expression softened slightly. 
There's no turning back now... Gripping 
the carrot tight, I racked my brains with 
all my might. And then—
choice_data_list:
...Protect the king! The Carrot Knight has 
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Go on ahead. You are to protect the 
king, are you not? —Sir Carrot Knight."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hey. You are to turn that into treasure.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Sleight of hand or sorcery, I care not. Be 
quick and do it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: By royal command. —Do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, Orfevre's 
unreasonable demands continued, and her 
mood grew worse and worse...
